svg.aria-label: Visual summary: versioned contracts and consumer-driven contract testing
svg.title: Versioned Contracts and Contract Testing
svg.desc: Presentation support diagram: what an API contract is, backward-compatibility rules, Pact-based contract testing, and a real production incident.
svg.text: How to stop a change in one service from silently breaking another
The contract is the source of truth
Both sides code against the same versioned promise
Conventions: UTC/ISO-8601 timestamps · page and limit pagination · UUIDs
One error envelope: { error: { code, message, details, trace_id } }
— the golden rule of contract-first design
Remove, rename, or retype a field
Consumers on v1 keep working while they migrate to v2.
If the producer breaks the consumer's promise,
ITS build fails in CI — before it ever reaches production.
A real scenario: the silent rename that broke production
out of stock — no test failed
